gates.description: At least one component file must be produced
No TypeScript 'any' types in production components
Tests must be produced alongside components
Async components must handle loading state

anti_patterns.description: Passing props through 4+ levels of components that don't use them
A single file with 500+ lines handling state, data fetching, rendering, and events
Putting form data and UI state into a global store
Parent renders → child mounts → child fetches → grandchild renders → grandchild fetches
Using !important to override styles — indicates specificity architecture problem

escalation_triggers: Design spec requires a layout causing performance issues (>100 DOM repaints/s)
A third-party dependency has a known security vulnerability with no patch
API response shape does not match the agreed contract, blocking frontend work
Accessibility audit reveals WCAG AA violations requiring design changes
Performance budget exceeded and optimization alone cannot fix it

input_requirements.description: Spec.md with UI requirements and acceptance criteria
